preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferAdmin)
Attacker must hold some BURNING tokens to execute the exploit

exploit_hint: As owner, call forceSwapAndSendDividends with a large token amount to drain contract's BNB balance. First ensure contract has accumulated fees (buyAmount/sellAmount) by making trades. Then call forceSwapAndSendDividends with tokens equal to contract's balance, which will swap tokens for BNB and send dividends to marketing/dev wallets (controlled by owner). Alternatively, use airdropToWallets to transfer tokens to attacker-controlled wallets without fees.
